problem:
Which of the following vector-valued functions are continuous at $t=0?$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(t) & =⟨{t}^{2},\,7t+6,\,3-{t}^{3}⟩ \\ g(t) & =⟨1,\,{t}^{2/3},\,t⟩ \\ h(t) & =⟨{t}^{2},\,\sqrt[3]{t},\,2t+3⟩\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
A vector-valued function is continuous at a point if and only if each of its components is continuous at that point. 

Let's consider the functions one-by-one. 

- The function $f(t)$ is continuous at $t=0$ because each of its components ${t}^{2}$, $7t+6$ and $3-{t}^{3}$are continuous at $t=0.$

- The function $g(t)$ is continuous at $t=0$ because each of its components $1$,  ${t}^{2/3}$ and $t$  are continuous at $t=0.$

- The function $h(t)$ is continuous at $t=0$ because each of its components ${t}^{2}$, $\sqrt[3]{t}$ and $2t+3$ are continuous at $t=0.$

Therefore, the answer is:

$\,$ All the functions are continuous at $t=0$

choices.value: All the functions are continuous at $t=0$
